THE SEAM THE WHOLE PIPELINE RESTS ON, and it had no owner. Twelve controls existed.

THE EXCLUDED OUTCOME is a replayed request served because the tier could not answer. That is what a bare boolean produces: 'not found' and 'could not look up' collapse into one value, and the safe reading of the collapsed value is whichever the caller happened to choose. Here the caller cannot choose — the type has no arm for it.

THE PANIC CONJUNCT is a different failure with the same effect: a poisoned lock that panicked would turn a per-request refusal into a worker-terminating panic on every LATER request, so one bad request takes the tier out for all of them. Both failures the reference cache owns — the poisoned lock and the entry ceiling — are error VALUES.

THE FAIL-CLOSED DEFAULT on the durability class is what keeps a new backend from being wired as though it were shared. A per-node in-memory cache does not prevent cross-node replays, and a backend that forgot to declare would otherwise be indistinguishable from one that had.

NOT A DEPLOYMENT'S TIER: InMemoryReplayCache declares itself single-process, and whether any deployed cache is shared, durable or linearizable is THM-0106's and THM-0107's; the tier's fail-closed ORDERING is THM-0092's. Not the pipeline's ordering either — that the cache is consulted only AFTER the signature verifies, so invalid-signature garbage cannot burn a legitimate nonce, is the verification pipeline's to state.
